image_prompt.text: An open forest clearing sized for a crowd of avatars to congregate in
A large distinct tree or rock formation visible from a distance so players can tell where they are in the forest
The arrival point among the trees, placed so the first thing a player sees is a composed view down the forest
A dense forest of varied trees covering the whole map
Birds flying around above and between the trees

layout_placement.text: Arrival point placed in the forest clearing

notes: Classified no-genre: the prompt names a place and a mood, not a game type. Entertainment's hangout reading was close - recorded in gaps.skill_gap.
All five axes left at default, so the route is P0: exterior, single-surface, single zone.
Players are said to use their own avatars, so no morph or costume system should be assumed.
